title: A C1 control character inside a comment
notes: Comment text is `#` followed by non-break characters (production 75), and production 27 takes them from the printable characters (production 1), which exclude U+0080 to U+0084 and U+0086 to U+009F (U+0085 is printable). U+009F is the first character that cannot belong: line 1, column 4 (`#`, a space, `c`, then the control).

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted any character but a line break in a comment.
